description: Gare e appalti is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna - Segreteria Generale. Pubblicazione dell'elenco delle procedure di gara aggiudicate. Dati primari indicati nel file: Tipo Appalto; Oggetto determina; Servizio; Responsabile del procedimento di gara; Aggiudicatario; Importo di aggiudicazione; Link Elaborati di Gara. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Governo e settore pubblico. Its keywords are PA alleata di cittadini e imprese, Imprese, trasparenza. The portal shows 27,103 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
